agenda_text:
PEDESTRIAN SAFETY ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JULY 9, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 4:00 PM

Wendy Ili, Vice Chair  Kaferman Guan, Member
Jill Birdwell, Member  Rhea Lewitzki, Member
Brandi Brown-Shock, Member  Michelle Mowery, Member
Roberto Castillo, Member  Danielle Potter, Member

Paul Van Dyk, City Traffic Engineer, Chair  Shannon Hilleshiem, PTA Representative
Diane Golden, Nonpublic Schools Representative  Kezia Bailey, LBUSD Representative

  SPECIAL MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55266  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Pedestrian Safety Advisory
  Committee meeting of Wednesday, December 11, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55267  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Ralph M. Brown Act
  from the City Attorney’s Office.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55268  Recommendation to approve prioritization factors for school guard placement
  beyond Long Beach Municipal Code (LBMC) Section 10.68.010. The factors for
  crossing guard placement include but not limited to vehicle speeds, collision
  history, proximity to schools, traffic control measures, pedestrian counts, staffing at
  locations with fewer lanes, and the feasibility of reducing the number of guards.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55269  Recommendation to receive and file a summary of newly proposed prioritization
  factors of collison history, speeds, and pedestrian counts.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Pedestrian Safety Advisory Committee on non-agenda items. Each
